name: Cabbage Stir Fry
instructions: Chop cabbage and garlic. Heat oil in a pan, add ingredients, stir fry, and drizzle with soy sauce.

name: Apple Salad
instructions: Slice the apple and mix with lettuce and walnuts. Drizzle with your favorite dressing.

name: Tomato Soup
instructions: Simmer chopped tomatoes with garlic and basil in water. Blend until smooth and season with salt.
